news.headline: Nykaa Q2 Results: PAT soars 207% YoY to Rs 101 crore, revenue up 28%; co to acquire 82% stake in Simply Nam
news.summary: Nykaa reported a 207% year-on-year profit surge to Rs 101 crore in Q2FY27, with revenue rising 28% to Rs 3,006 crore. Beauty and fashion businesses accelerated growth, while quick commerce, owned brands and strategic acquisitions strengthened expansion.

news.headline: SBI share price target: Jefferies, Motilal, others see up to 34% upside in state lender. Buy, sell or hold?
news.summary: State Bank of India has seen a remarkable 15% increase in profits year-on-year, totaling Rs 23,038 crore for the second quarter. With a loan book surpassing Rs 52 lakh crore and a 10% rise in interest income, brokerages have set optimistic Buy ratings on SBI shares, suggesting target prices between Rs 1,225 and Rs 1,350. Despite this positive outlook, management highlighted possible obstacles from macroeconomic shifts and potential treasury losses.

news.headline: Equitas Small Finance Bank shares jump 9% after Balaji Nuthalapadi’s appointment as interim CEO
news.summary: The bank further said that appointment of Nuthalapadi as interim CEO, consequent to the resignation of P. N. Vasudevan as the MD & CEO, shall take effect from the date of RBI approval or such other date as may be stipulated by the RBI in this regard.

news.headline: European shares rise as banks, clean energy stocks rally; Novo Nordisk jumps
news.summary: European shares advanced after Democrats secured both chambers of the US Congress, lifting investor sentiment. Banks and clean-energy stocks led the rally, while Novo Nordisk gained after raising its full-year sales and profit forecasts.

news.headline: Eurozone bond yields steady as investors await inflation data; US Treasury yields ease after midterm elections
news.summary: Eurozone government bond yields were steady as investors awaited October inflation data, while US Treasury yields declined after Democrats gained control of both chambers of Congress. Markets also assessed the likelihood of further European Central Bank rate hikes in December.

news.headline: Glittering Prospects: Why Gold is the ultimate sweet spot this Dhanteras
news.summary: Gold is trading over 20% below its peak ahead of Dhanteras, offering long-term investors a potential staggered buying opportunity. Central-bank demand, ETF inflows and rupee weakness could support prices, with analysts projecting returns of 15–20% by next Dhanteras.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics shares gain 3% as Motilal raises target price after Q2; Elara Capital upgrades to Buy
news.summary: Bharat Electronics shares gained after Motilal Oswal raised its price target and Elara Capital upgraded its rating to Buy. Brokerages cited strong order visibility, healthy revenue growth and margin prospects, while delays in major defence orders remain a key risk.

news.headline: Diwali dhamaka stocks: Eternal, ICICI Bank, among 10 with upside of up to 34%
news.summary: As the cautious journey of Samvat 2083 unfolds against a backdrop of external challenges, JM Financial unveils ten promising stocks for Diwali investment. ICICI Bank stands out for anticipated returns and robust loan growth. Bharat Electronics and Eternal are recognized for their strategic sector positions and remarkable growth prospects. In light of a volatile market shaped by global incidents, these selections embody long-term growth potential despite current economic uncertainties.

news.headline: Diwali 2026: Will banking stocks shine in Samvat 2083? Analysts list top picks
news.summary: With Diwali 2026 on the horizon, banking stocks like HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Karur Vysya Bank are drawing attention from analysts as potential winners for Samvat 2083. Following a period of volatility, these stocks are anticipated to regain momentum, driven by consistent loan growth and enhanced management practices. Investors are advised to navigate the changing landscape prudently as opportunities unfold.

news.headline: Titan Company Q2 results preview: Profit may rise up to 27% YoY; jewellery growth, margins in focus
news.summary: Titan Company is set to release its financial results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. Brokerage forecasts suggest revenue growth could range from 18.8% to 27% compared to the previous year. Additionally, a substantial year-on-year profit increase of around 27% is anticipated. Key focal points will include jewellery performance, margins, and the growth trajectory of CaratLane, with brokerages recommending a buy on Titan shares due to potential upside.

news.headline: China Banks' applications for PBOC stock loan scheme exceed 200 billion yuan
news.summary: China's central bank said applications for loans under its stock-purchase financing scheme have exceeded 200 billion yuan. The PBOC has also cut the relending rate to 1%, stepping up efforts to support share buybacks and stabilise equity markets.

news.headline: AMD forecasts fourth-quarter revenue above estimates on strong AI chip demand
news.summary: Advanced Micro Devices estimates its fourth-quarter revenue will hit about $17 billion, driven primarily by robust demand for AI chips. Although the company's forecast for adjusted gross margin stands at 55%, it falls slightly short of analyst expectations. A remarkable 97% year-on-year increase in data-centre revenue showcases AMD's growth. However, the company currently faces challenges in sourcing high-bandwidth memory, essential for its AI processors.

news.headline: NSE shares gain as Jefferies, other brokerages remain bullish after Q2 results. What lies ahead?
news.summary: NSE reported a 23% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 2,578 crore, driven by higher trading volumes and transaction revenue. The exchange also approved divesting up to 40% stake in its coal exchange subsidiary. Jefferies and Emkay maintained Buy ratings, projecting further upside in NSE shares.

news.headline: Two SME IPOs list today: Carver Roboweld, Ajwa Projects shares make BSE SME debut
news.summary: Ajwa Projects and Carver Roboweld are set to list on the BSE SME platform on November 4, 2026, after collectively raising Rs 66.34 crore. While Ajwa Projects’ IPO received modest subscription of 1.12 times, Carver Roboweld attracted strong investor demand, achieving an overall subscription of 25.80 times.

news.headline: Bitcoin near $78,600, Ethereum at $2,300 as US midterm results put crypto regulation in focus
news.summary: Bitcoin traded near $78,000 as institutional outflows and macroeconomic uncertainty kept sentiment cautious across the cryptocurrency market. Investors tracked US midterm election results, potential changes in crypto regulation, Federal Reserve rate expectations, and ETF flows for cues on the market's next move.
